tool.name: SetUpPythonEnvironment
tool.summary: Create an ArcGIS Pro Python environment with the packages SGTool, Tomofast-x and GeoSubSampler need, and make it the environment ArcGIS Pro uses.
tool.usage:
Creates a NEW environment as a copy of arcgispro-py3; it does not change arcgispro-py3 or any other environment you already have.

Needs an internet connection and takes about 10 minutes. Restart ArcGIS Pro when it has finished to use the new environment.

The same tool is in the SGTool, Tomofast-x and GeoSubSampler toolboxes; one run covers all three. Running it again only adds what is missing.

It cannot change or delete the environment ArcGIS Pro is using at the time: to recreate it, switch to another environment in Project > Package Manager and restart first.

param.name: env_name
param.dialogReference: Name of the environment to create (or to add missing packages to, if it exists).
param.pythonReference: Name of the environment to create (or to add missing packages to, if it exists).

param.name: activate
param.displayname: Make it the active ArcGIS Pro environment
param.dialogReference: Make the new environment the one ArcGIS Pro uses (restart ArcGIS Pro afterwards). Untick to activate it later in Project > Package Manager.
param.pythonReference: Make the new environment the one ArcGIS Pro uses (restart ArcGIS Pro afterwards). Untick to activate it later in Project > Package Manager.

param.name: recreate
param.displayname: Delete the environment first if it already exists
param.dialogReference: Delete the environment and make it again from a fresh copy of arcgispro-py3, instead of only adding what is missing.
param.pythonReference: Delete the environment and make it again from a fresh copy of arcgispro-py3, instead of only adding what is missing.
